levels.surface: عبد الواحد بن محمد بن عبدوس العطار النيسابوري

notes: «قلت للرضا عليه السلام» — the Imam who is asked and answers is the last link (rule 11, owner ruling 2); the «ل» of «للرضا» is a preposition and stays out of the surface
«قد روي عن آبائك» in the question names the Imam's fathers only inside the question: not links
«يا ابن رسول الله» is a form of address, not a name

fixes.reason: THQ's English gives a different chain (Muhammad b. Hasan b. Ahmad b. Walid, al-Saffar, Ibn Abi Umayr, Abu Abdillah) that the text does not write.

evidence.quote: حدثنا عبد الواحد بن محمد بن عبدوس
We were told by Muhammed bin Hasan bin Ahmad bin Waleed
